newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight unchanged, averages 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight unchanged, averages 10 pct.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound ranged from 9-3/4 to 10-1/4 percent in a quiet private sector market on Tuesday, unchanged from Monday.
Several bankers said they did not perform overnight or one-week transactions on the pound. Two bankers said one-week rates ranged between 10-1/8 to 10-1/4.
State-owned banks kept their minimum overnight lending rate at 10-1/2 percent, bankers said.
